The '''Garena Premier League 2013 Spring''' was the Spring split of the [[Garena Premier League]] ('''GPL''') 2013 season, held online from January 4 to April 21, 2013. Eight teams from across Southeast Asia competed, marking an expansion from previous editions of the league. The Group Stage was played as a Quadruple Round Robin with best-of-one matches. The first-place team qualified directly for the [[Garena Premier League/2013/Championship|Garena Premier League 2013 Championship]], while all remaining teams were eliminated from the split but retained eligibility to qualify through the Summer split. The tournament featured a total prize pool of $100,000 {{Abbr/USD}}.
